title: क्या सुधर रहा है
caption: तीन महीने बाद मीरा देखना चाहती थी कि क्या सचमुच सुधार हुआ है। लूमी उसकी कहानी सुनाती है।
linkedin_text: ScoreMyBiz keeps every saved score with the change since the last one, a trend, and a look at whether the moves the owner marked Done were followed by a better, same or worse score. It compares scores before and after; it does not prove the move caused the change.

cast.meera: Meera, a young Indian woman who runs a small bakery, with her hair tied back, in a cream apron over a green kurta

scenes.clip: Lumi, a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a navy blazer and white top, facing the camera in a small bakery with trays of bread and cakes behind her, a warm smile.
